text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's time you fulfilled your promise.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Agh... Really?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka wails as Aston Machan squares up
to her.
What in the world is going on
here? I ask Machan
to enlighten me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When was it again? I believe it was just
as we
started the second half of classic
year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What's your best distance, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That came outta nowhere. Why do you
wanna
know?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I thought you were a miler, but
then I
realized you also seem pretty
good at medium
distances.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! What can I say? Killin' every
distance is
what makes me so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But... if I had to choose one, I guess it'd be miles! "Ruler of the Mile" sounds damn cool, don't ya think?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you and I are the same. If
we're
talking miles, I won't lose to
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...That so?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You really think you can beat me? I'm
gettin'
pretty fast, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wonder... I've gotten pretty quick
myself
lately.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After that, we made a bet to see who
could win
more famous mile races during
the Twinkle Series.
The winner gets to
make one demand of the loser.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How the hell did I let this happen?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Still, I guess I did lose. So, what's it gonna be? Out with it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've already decided.
Vodka. I want you
to...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Teach me how to be cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm what you would call "lovely." It's
nice, but
loveliness doesn't overlap with
coolness. So, if
you'd be so kind...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! There's nothin' in this world
cooler than
motorcycles! They've got
everything!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
From the heavy roar of the engine to the
sleek,
shinin' body! Plus, they tear down
the road like a
bullet!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just picture it! Flyin' down the road in an
epic
chase, knees grazin' the road as you
turn!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Knees grazing the road?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A pack of bikes roarin' down the
highway. You
and me, neck and neck at
the front!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Neck and neck...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then, at the top of a hill, I say, "Ain't
nobody can
stop me." ...Wait, no. I say,
"Nothin' stops me but
the settin' sun."
Wait, hold on...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How about this? "Even after sundown,
this birdie's
gotta fly!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! Yeah, that's not half bad! I like that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Right! Now, we make it a reality! Hop on
your air
bike and let's roll!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Vrrrrrmmm!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vrrrmmm, vrrrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Vodka and Machan
text_block_list.text: Vrrrrrmmm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Everything else aside, Machan looks
like she's
enjoying her lesson on how to
be cool,
Vodka-style.
